1: Lo, hope as to him is belied: is not one cast down even at the sight of him?
2: None is so bold as to stir him up; and who is he that will stand before me?
3: Who hath first given to me, that I should repay [him]? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.
4: I will not be silent as to his parts, the story of his power, and the beauty of his structure.
5: Who can uncover the surface of his garment? who can come within his double jaws?
6: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.
7: The rows of his shields are a pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal.
8: One is so near to another that no air can come between them;
9: They are joined each to its fellow; they stick together, and cannot be sundered.
10: His sneezings flash light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
11: Out of his mouth go forth flames; sparks of fire leap out:
12: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a boiling pot and cauldron.
13: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
14: In his neck lodgeth strength, and terror danceth before him.
15: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are fused upon him, they cannot be moved.
16: His heart is firm as a stone, yea, firm as the nether [millstone].
17: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: they are beside themselves with consternation.
18: If any reach him with a sword, it cannot hold; neither spear, nor dart, nor harpoon.
19: He esteemeth iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.
20: The arrow will not make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
21: Clubs are counted as stubble; he laugheth at the shaking of a javelin.
22: His under parts are sharp potsherds: he spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.
23: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment;
24: He maketh the path to shine after him: one would think the deep to be hoary.
25: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
26: He beholdeth all high things; he is king over all the proud beasts.
